heading: AI Engineering — From Foundations to Production
lede: I am independently studying graduate-level computer science and artificial intelligence coursework while building, testing, and evaluating AI systems. This section documents my development through technical study, hands-on implementations, engineering decisions, and public evidence.
standfirst: Everything here is organised around evidence rather than credentials. Coursework appears with its source and status; an implementation appears with its repository, its tests, and what it does not handle. Where I have no evidence yet, the page says so.
meta_description: Joseph Morante's AI engineering work: independent graduate-level CS and AI study, implementations with tests, and evaluated systems.
og_description: Coursework, independent implementations, and tested artifacts across ML foundations, language models, agents, MLOps, and evaluation.
disclosure: I am independently studying courses from the University of Colorado Boulder MS-CS and MS-AI curricula through Coursera's open, non-credit versions. I am not enrolled in either degree programme, am not taking these for graduate credit, and am not pursuing an awarded CU Boulder degree. The curricula are organised here by the universities' own degree requirements purely as a study reference.
